response.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM account GROUP BY district_id), r AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rnk FROM d) SELECT district_id, account_count, share FROM r WHERE share >= (SELECT share FROM (SELECT share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rn FROM d) WHERE rn = 10) ORDER BY share DESC
